description: This file contains utility methods for throwing exceptions, specifically related to invalid operations and not implemented exceptions, as part of the PdfSharp internal utilities.

classes.name: TH2
classes.description: A static class providing exception helper methods for internal use within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_ToDo
methods.description: Creates a new InvalidOperationException with a message optionally including additional info.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidOperationException_ToDo
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException with an optional message.

methods.name: NotImplementedException
methods.description: Creates a new NotImplementedException with a message optionally including additional info and inner exception.

methods.name: ThrowNotImplementedException
methods.description: Throws a NotImplementedException with an optional message and inner exception.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidOperationException_HandleIsNotPinned
methods.description: Throws a generic exception indicating handle is not pinned, intended for internal checks.
